name: Elder Guardian
description: The Winterworks Elder Guardian boss in the vanilla mob style: a big boxy body of pale, aged prismarine plates crusted with moss, one simple flat glowing eye under a heavy stone brow, a crown of twelve tapering spikes that slide out, flat armoured fins and a stepped tail ending in a fan. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
